The Retroid Dual Screen uses its own brightness buttons. Automatic brightness sync is unavailable on the tested Odin 3 setup.

Show the same image on both screens. Adjust the Odin brightness in Quick Settings or Display settings, then use the Retroid screen’s brightness buttons to match it by eye.

For a consistent match, turn off adaptive brightness on the Odin. The screens have different brightness ranges, so equal slider percentages do not mean equal brightness.
Open Display settings from Android Settings.

1. Start protection or turn on Auto protect.
2. Connect your Retroid Dual Screen.
3. Wait for Protected, then return to your launcher.

Protection keeps running when you swipe OdinDuo away from recent apps and during sleep.

Auto protect stays ready between connections and resumes after a restart. Stop protection turns Auto protect off too.

Use Check setup to add the OdinDuo Quick Settings tile. Tap the tile to enable Auto protect or stop protection without opening the app.

Keeping the connected USB display awake may use extra battery. Unplugging or stopping restores normal USB power management.

After Android’s Force stop or its Active apps Stop, open OdinDuo again to resume.

Built for AYN Odin 3 and Retroid Dual Screen. No root installation needed.
